jobs.title: Field Test Engineer
jobs.description_text: What you’ll do Plan and run scenario cases at proving grounds: translate a case specification into a test procedure, set up instrumented targets and VUT’s, define approach conditions and tolerance bands, and execute enough valid runs to support a result. Run scenario cases on public roads with safety drivers, route and condition selection to actually encounter the target scenario, in-vehicle protocol, driver briefing, abort criteria, and disciplined recording of what occurred. Keep staged and opportunistic encounters clearly distinct, because they are not the same evidence. Own the risk assessment for the testing itself: site layout, personnel positions, exclusion zones, emergency stop provisions, weather and surface limits, and the conditions under which a test does not run. You hold the call to stop, and we expect you to use it. Own instrumentation and ground truth - ego positioning, target position and velocity, timing synchronisation, video and data acquisition. A run that cannot be reconstructed from its data did not produce evidence. Own tolerance bands, the number of valid runs a result requires, and the rejection of runs that fall outside them, with the reason recorded. Nobody downstream can audit this if you do not. Write test reports a safety case engineer can cite directly: what was run, under what conditions, against what criteria, with what outcome, and every deviation from the procedure.
